name: Councilman Millstipe
summary: In Darkshire, Councilman Millstipe wants justice for Duskwood's people. He lives in the town hall as the council grows bitter over Stormwind's rule.

sections.title: Justice Denied by Stormwind
sections.body: Undead and ferocious beasts threaten Darkshire, while its council wrestles with Stormwind City's bureaucracy. Councilman Millstipe shares the town's growing bitterness toward the crown. The grave robber Dextren Ward was caught selling freshly dug corpses to the necromancer Morbent Fel. Darkshire's leaders sentenced Ward to death, but Stormwind's House of Nobles commuted the execution and locked him away in the Stormwind Stockade.

sections.title: A Message to the Nobles
sections.body: Councilman Millstipe believes Stormwind's politicians have set Duskwood's safety and justice aside. In secret, he directs adventurers to kill Dextren Ward in his Stockade cell. The order defies the House of Nobles. If Stormwind will not protect Duskwood's people, Millstipe believes they must take justice into their own hands.

faq.q: Where can Councilman Millstipe be found?
faq.answer: Councilman Millstipe can be found inside Darkshire's town hall, in eastern Duskwood.

faq.q: Why does Millstipe want Dextren Ward dead?
faq.answer: Dextren Ward dug up Duskwood's dead and sold them to the necromancer Morbent Fel. Lord Ebonlocke sentenced him to be beheaded, but Stormwind's House of Nobles spared him and sent him to the Stockade.

faq.q: What is Millstipe's grievance with Stormwind?
faq.answer: Millstipe believes Stormwind has abandoned Duskwood while interfering with its local justice. The House of Nobles overturned Darkshire's death sentence for Dextren Ward, leaving the settlement feeling ignored and unprotected by the throne.

faq.q: Does Millstipe have any known family?
faq.answer: No family of Councilman Millstipe is known.

angles.text: Millstipe shows the divide between Stormwind's sheltered nobility and Duskwood's desperate frontier settlements. Those settlements receive little aid and face heavy-handed interference from the capital.
For a rogue willing to enter the heavily guarded Stockade and carry out an unsanctioned political execution, Millstipe offers work against the House of Nobles.
